output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. It comes from build 7.4.0. On 7.4.0, crash rates were already about 2% on 2–3 Sep, before the flag ramp. Users on 7.3.2 stayed near 0.7%. Within 7.4.0, flag-on users (2.10%) and the random flag-off holdout (1.98%) are nearly the same, and the difference is within noise. Only 7.4.0 users can have the flag, so the flag and the build were confounded in the dashboard. The leading crash cluster, 41% of events, is a native crash in the upgraded Pixelda image library. It is new in 7.4.0 and has no canvas frames. The app-store console's separate crash counts agree, so this is not a reporting artifact. Device mix and usage are the same across groups. The sync-service deploy is not the cause, because 7.3.2 did not change after 9 Sep. A small flag effect, a few tenths of a point, cannot be ruled out yet. Do not take the planned path. Turning the flag off and releasing 7.4.0 to 100% would ship the real crash problem to everyone. Hold 7.4.0 at 25% and fix the Pixelda crash. Keep the flag holdout running to measure any small flag effect. Do not roll back the reporting SDK.
